estimates.assumptions: 8 whole fresh sardines (edible portion only, ~60g each after cleaning; typical small-medium grilling size); fish has no carbs or fiber
2 tablespoons olive oil (standard 14g per tbs, all used in marinade and drizzling); pure oil has no carbs or fiber
3 garlic cloves (~9g total, minced in marinade); standard garlic carb values
1 tablespoon smoked or sweet paprika (~7g, all used in marinade); standard paprika values
Juice from 1/2 lemon plus wedges (~50g juice + rind contribution, all used); standard lemon values
4 fresh rosemary sprigs (~8g total, leaves stripped into marinade; negligible calories); standard rosemary values
1 fresh red chilli (~20g, deseeded or whole, sliced into marinade); standard red chili values
